all_the_feels.limit: one tactile hero at a time; do not cover real detail with texture

surreal_silliness.limit: never use when it weakens proof, safety, or product truth

local_flavor.limit: specific lived detail, not generic cultural decoration

hao_fusion_rules: Trend is a routing hint, never a mandatory skin.
Hao reference-derived hierarchy, typography and color discipline remain the base standard.
Real footage and narrative evidence always outrank trend decoration.
At most one trend signal may dominate a scene; supporting signals stay subtle.
Longform uses trends as chapter punctuation; Shorts may use a bolder first-frame or payoff accent.
